resolution: The free brush painted hard-edged binary discs, so strokes were staircased piles of aliased blobs (the jagged 'TesT' screenshot) — not a smooth line to be found. Two fixes: (1) paintStamp now antialiases each dab — full coverage inside the disc, ramping to zero across a 1-texel boundary, blended into flow — so a stroke reads as a smooth line instead of a hard staircase (framework, needs rebuild). (2) Entering the brush auto-picks a paint resolution from the model's tri count (cube/low-poly -> 256 for crisp text, dense meshes stay coarse; host still clamps to the atlas budget) so painting is usable without touching the resolution menu — a stopgap approximating the real texels-per-area density knob. Shas: fd3b1b9c2 (AA, framework), 63279d13b (auto-detail, cart hot-reload). The architecture density rework (per-face -> per-area) is discussed but parked as a someday; it is NOT blocking usable painting now.
